sections.title: Data Science Using ChatGPT
sections.description: Large Language Models (LLMs) such as ChatGPTs are enabling data scientists to shift their focus from hands-on coding, data-wrangling, and conducting analyses to designing questions, assessing and managing analyses and translating results into decisions. Students can benefit by equipping themselves with practical data science skills that leverage artificial intelligence tools/large language models such as ChatGPT. This course will cover all aspects of a standard data science pipeline including Data Preparation and Cleaning, Visualization, Model building, Interpretation and Presentation.

sections.title: Data Science Using ChatGPT: Modern Statistical Methods
sections.description: Large Language Models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT are reshaping how statisticians approach data analysis: enabling a shift from manual coding and computation to strategic thinking in statistical modeling, interpretation, and decision-making. This course develops advanced statistical skills by integrating AI tools to enhance statistical methodologies. It offers an intermediate-level exploration of modern statistical techniques, including generative classification, time series modeling, Bayesian inference, and survival analysis. Using structured prompt engineering techniques, ChatGPT will serve primarily as a computational and programming assistant. Students will focus on deepening their conceptual understanding and applying methods in practical contexts. The course emphasizes shifting attention from coding mechanics to statistical insight and real-world application through case studies. A mixed assessment strategy will be used - some evaluations incorporating ChatGPT and others in traditional paper-based formats to ensure students build both AI-assisted and independent competencies for modern statistical practice.
